thesis: A disciplined, lowly levered specialty insurer earning high-teens ROE trades below peers and low in its own EV/EBITDA range while in a healthy uptrend, with buybacks compounding per-share value through a softening cycle.
reason: Scorecard conviction 4: high returns, low leverage, a low position in its own multiple range and trend strength outweigh a cyclically softening reinsurance market. The bear case is real, so only the standard core size, which Python volatility-scales. No cap is breached and Financials is unheld, so nothing is replaced.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 12%, showing the soft cycle is eroding returns beyond a normal cyclical dip.
TTM ROE falls below 14%, well under the 18.7% now, signalling underwriting returns have broken down.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 1.5x, reversing the deleveraging.
Reinsurance net premiums written decline by more than 15% year on year for two consecutive quarters in the 10-Q.
